review: Constructor supports explicit name/year override; JSON loader resolves identity for canonical filenames, guards missing group list and reads UTF-8-sig. Numerical group/diet/detritus extraction functions are unchanged. Legacy filename parsing has first priority, preserving legacy model identity. PPRCalculator uses model identity in diagnostics labels, not scientific equations.
reuse_condition: This code review is not by itself a per-model numerical proof. A region may reuse exact accepted historical full matrices/settings after checking protected input identity and current loaded groups/DC/det_fate against retained or old-loader state. Engine hashes remain different and must be stated honestly.
